name: incident-response
description: Reactive incident handler: a webhook posts an alert, judge-severity routes by stakes, and critical/high incidents get a REVERSIBLE mitigation proposed, gated by judge-risk (auto / human-review / block) before any action runs — then a root-cause follow-up is filed. Mitigate first, fix later. Wire the webhook to your alerting (PagerDuty, Sentry, CloudWatch).

phases.name: triage-severity
phases.description: Score the incident by impact × blast-radius × reversibility × urgency, then route proportionally.

phases.name: propose-mitigation
phases.description: Fastest reversible action to stop the bleeding — with its rollback.

phases.name: risk-gate
phases.description: Decide how much autonomy the mitigation gets: reversible+confident → auto; otherwise human review; unsafe → block.

auto.name: auto-mitigate
auto.description: Apply the reversible mitigation (flag-off / rollback) automatically.

review.name: approve-mitigation
review.description: Hold for a human to approve before applying the mitigation.

block.name: escalate-blocked
block.description: Mitigation judged unsafe — escalate to a human, do not run it.

phases.name: file-followup
phases.description: Open a root-cause follow-up ticket. Mitigation ≠ fix — the durable fix goes through normal intake.

phases.name: approve-and-mitigate
phases.description: High severity always gets a human nod before mitigating.

medium.name: open-ticket
medium.description: Real but limited — file a normal ticket; no mitigation needed.

low.name: acknowledge
low.description: Minor/cosmetic — log an acknowledgement and move on.
